code_summary: Train the incumbent FM+BPR+recency-history configuration once with epoch-score capture enabled, then compare checkpoint-combination rules using only stored per-epoch validation predictions. The script uses held-out user-split testing to choose between the single best epoch and top-N averaging, then applies the chosen rule to generate final valid/test scores. Existing menu primitives can request checkpoint averaging, but they cannot replace the built-in same-validation selection rule with a held-out user-split decision over stored epoch predictions.
